# JsonParser

A parser over a document.

pub struct JsonParser {
    // private fields

## Constructors

<h3 id="new"><code>JsonParser</code></h3>

```rux
pub func JsonParser(allocator: Allocator, input: char8[..], limits: JsonLimits) -> JsonParser
```

A parser over `input` under `limits`, rejecting duplicate names.

| Name        | Type         | Description                            |
| ----------- | ------------ | -------------------------------------- |
| `allocator` | `Allocator`  | where the storage comes from           |
| `input`     | `char8[..]`  | the text to read                       |
| `limits`    | `JsonLimits` | the bounds the parse refuses to exceed |

**Returns**: a parser ready to read the input

<h3 id="failure"><code>Failure</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Failure(self: &JsonParser) -> JsonParseError?
```

Whether parsing stopped, and why.
`none` while nothing has gone wrong, which for a parser that has finished means the document was read.
A caller using [`Parse`](/docs/api/json/json-parser#parse) never needs this: the failure comes back in the result.

**Returns**: the failure, positioned, or `none`

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Json/Src/Parser.rux#L268)

<h3 id="parse"><code>Parse</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Parse(self: &var JsonParser) -> JsonValue ! JsonParseError
```

Parses the whole document and returns its top-level value, or why it could not.
Anything after that value is `TrailingContent` — a document is one value, and two concatenated ones are
not a document however well-formed each is.
A failure gives back nothing at all. Whatever had been built when the parser stopped is released here, which
is the only place that can be done once: an array that failed at its third element owns two, and handing
those back beside an error would leave a caller holding a document that is not one.
Fails with any case of [`JsonParseError`](/docs/api/json/json-parse-error), positioned at the byte where parsing stopped.

**Returns**: the document, or the failure that stopped it

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Json/Src/Parser.rux#L551)
